title: Professor absent for last 3 weeks without substitute
description: Our Data Structures lecturer has been absent for the past three weeks with no replacement faculty assigned. Half the syllabus is incomplete before midterms.

title: Incomplete syllabus coverage before end semester exams
description: The course instructor for Advanced Thermodynamics rushed through unit 4 and unit 5 in one lecture. We have not been provided reference notes or problem sets.

title: Unfair internal continuous assessment marks deduction
description: My internal assessment marks for Operating Systems lab were penalized by 15 marks despite submitting all lab records on time and attending all practicals.

title: Attendance discrepancy in student ERP portal
description: My recorded attendance in Signals and Systems shows 68% whereas my actual attendance signed on the physical register is 82%. This makes me falsely debarred from writing exams.

title: Clashing timetable for elective courses in 6th semester
description: Cloud Computing and Cyber Security electives are scheduled at the exact same hour on Mondays and Wednesdays. Dual enrolled students cannot attend both lectures.

title: Project mentor refusing to approve final capstone topic
description: Our assigned guide has rejected three revised capstone project proposals without constructive feedback and is not available during consultation hours.

title: Outdated syllabus taught in artificial intelligence course
description: The Machine Learning curriculum covers obsolete 2005 algorithms and lacks modern deep learning frameworks that are required for industrial placements.

title: Language barrier with newly appointed visiting faculty
description: The visiting mathematics professor does not lecture in English or clarify doubts in class, resulting in severe comprehension difficulties for non-native speakers.

title: Laboratory instructor not providing feedback on lab reports
description: All physics laboratory practical submissions have been kept without evaluation or feedback for the entire semester.

title: Assignment grading criteria not communicated beforehand
description: Students were marked down severely on the software engineering team project for formatting rules that were never stated in the project brief.

title: Tutorial sessions cancelled repeatedly by teaching assistants
description: The tutorial classes for Engineering Mechanics have not been conducted for the past month, leaving multiple problem sets unsolved.

title: Course credits mismatch between curriculum handbook and portal
description: The academic regulations handbook states 4 credits for Numerical Analysis but the portal shows 3 credits, affecting graduation calculations.

title: Department refused change of branch request despite CGPA
description: I achieved a 9.2 CGPA qualifying for branch transfer to Computer Science, but the academic council rejected the request without official explanation.

title: Disproportionate workload across elective subjects
description: The elective subject has 5 weekly assignments and two mini projects which violates the institute course credit guidelines.

title: Classroom lectures frequently rescheduled to late evenings
description: The department head is rescheduling morning core lectures to 6:30 PM, causing severe difficulties for day scholars commuting via public transport.

title: Examination admit card not generated on portal
description: The end-term examination portal shows 'Admit Card Withheld' even though all tuition dues and library clearances have been cleared.

title: Delay in re-evaluation results of 5th semester
description: I applied for re-evaluation of my Mathematics 3 paper two months ago. The supplementary exam date is approaching and re-check marks are still pending.

title: Spelling mistake on final official degree marksheet
description: My mother's name and my surname are misspelled on the provisional degree certificate and consolidated marksheet.

title: Examination hall ticket clash with competitive gate exam
description: The university semester exam timetable overlaps directly with the national GATE examination date, causing career disadvantage.

title: Incorrect subject code entered on end semester grade card
description: My grade card displays EE301 instead of CS301, showing an F grade for a subject I never registered for or attended.

title: Evaluation error in numerical question total calculation
description: Upon receiving the evaluated answer script photocopy, Question 4 marks were not added to the grand total on the front cover page.

title: Examination center allocated 60 km away from campus
description: The university has assigned an exam center in another district with no direct train or bus connectivity for the upcoming theory papers.

title: Malpractice allegation framed without providing evidence
description: The flying squad confiscated my answer sheet claiming unfair means without CCTV footage or any prohibited material on my desk.

title: Supplementary examination schedule published with 24 hours notice
description: The backlog timetable was posted yesterday evening for an exam scheduled tomorrow morning, providing zero revision time.

title: Online examination platform crashed during final quiz
description: The browser lockdown portal crashed 20 minutes into the test, auto-submitting incomplete answers with no opportunity for re-attempt.

title: Practical viva external examiner arrived 4 hours late
description: Students were kept waiting in the hallway from 9 AM to 2 PM without food or seating arrangements for the chemistry practical viva.

title: Duplicate question paper booklet issued in final exam
description: The question paper distributed had 4 pages missing from Section B, leading to lost time during the university examination.

title: Grade point average calculation formula error in transcript
description: The SGPA recorded on the student dashboard does not match the credit-weighted average outlined in the academic statute.

title: Grace marks not awarded as per university ordinance
description: I am short by 1 mark to clear the threshold for passing and am entitled to 2 grace marks under Ordinance 12, but the controller denied it.

title: Late fee charged for examination registration due to portal downtime
description: The payment gateway was offline during the regular deadline day, and the system is now imposing a Rs. 1500 late registration fee.

title: Tuition fee refund not processed after admission withdrawal
description: I withdrew my admission within the UGC mandated 100% refund timeframe in August. The accounts section has not refunded the Rs. 85,000 tuition fee.

title: Double debit of semester tuition fees through payment gateway
description: While paying fees through the online portal, Rs. 60,000 was deducted twice from my bank account. The accounts office has not reversed the duplicate charge.

title: Unjustified caution deposit deduction on graduation clearance
description: The college accounts department deducted Rs. 5,000 from my refundable caution deposit citing general campus wear and tear without itemized dues.

title: Excess bus fee charged during online semester
description: Transport fee was charged for the full semester even though classes were held remotely and buses did not operate.

title: Official fee receipt not issued after bank transfer
description: NEFT transaction of semester fees was acknowledged by bank 10 days ago, but accounts clerk has not generated the stamped receipt required for education loan.

title: Late fee fine applied despite verified bank server delay
description: The bank took 48 hours to clear the RTGS, and the institute accounts section is imposing an unfair Rs. 2,000 late payment penalty.

title: Discrepancy in installment fee structure for economically weaker students
description: The approved fee installment plan agreed upon during admission is being revoked by the accounts officer who demands full payment.

title: Hostel mess rebate not credited for authorized leave days
description: I was on approved hospital leave for 20 days with medical certificate, but the mess accounts section refused to credit the daily rebate.

title: Discrepancy in convocation fee charged on portal
description: The university senate notification fixed the convocation fee at Rs. 1,000, but the portal is forcing students to pay Rs. 3,500.

title: Bank demand draft misplaced by accounts department
description: I submitted a physical DD of Rs. 45,000 at the counter with stamped receipt, but the portal still lists my fee status as unpaid.

title: Sudden unannounced fee hike mid-academic year
description: The institute announced a 25% hike in laboratory and development fees halfway through the academic year, in violation of admission prospectus.

title: Dispute regarding fine on unreturned library book that was paid
description: The library fine receipt of Rs. 300 was submitted, but the finance office portal continues to block no-dues clearance.

title: Health insurance premium deducted without policy card issuance
description: Mandatory student mediclaim fee of Rs. 1,200 was debited with semester fees, but no insurance policy number or card has been provided.

title: Examination re-checking fee refund for grade improvement
description: According to university rules, if marks increase by more than 10%, the re-evaluation fee is refundable. My marks increased by 14% but refund is pending.

title: Education loan disbursement acknowledgement letter delayed
description: The bank requires a demand letter and bonafide fee estimate for the next academic year to release loan tranche, which finance desk is delaying.

title: National scholarship portal verification pending at college nodal officer
description: The deadline for National Scholarship Portal (NSP) institutional verification is in 3 days, and the college nodal officer has not validated applications.

title: Post-matric scholarship disbursement delayed by 6 months
description: State government post-matric scholarship funds were released to the college account in March, but the administration has not credited it to student accounts.

title: Merit scholarship renewal withheld without explanation
description: I maintained an 8.8 CGPA exceeding the 8.0 criteria for merit scholarship renewal, but my second year scholarship instalment was rejected.

title: Incorrect income criteria documentation rejected by scholarship cell
description: The scholarship office rejected my father's revenue authority income certificate stating it needs tahsildar seal, which it already possesses.

title: Tuition fee waiver under TFW scheme not reflected in fee bill
description: I was admitted under the state AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) quota, but the institute fee counter is generating full tuition fee bills.

title: Research fellowship stipend delayed for doctoral scholars
description: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) monthly stipend has not been disbursed for four consecutive months, causing severe livelihood distress.

title: Single girl child scholarship portal form not endorsed by registrar
description: The UGC Pragati/Single Girl Child scheme application requires the head of institute sign and seal, which has been lying on the desk for two weeks.

title: SC/ST scholarship fee reimbursement adjustment delay
description: The social welfare department scholarship has been sanctioned, but the college refuses to issue hall ticket until funds hit the college account.

title: MHRD GATE scholarship attendance tracking missing in portal
description: The M.Tech GATE stipend attendance portal was not updated by the department coordinator, resulting in forfeiture of this month's allowance.

title: Sports quota scholarship incentive award not disbursed
description: Students who represented the university at All India Inter-University Games have not received the approved cash incentive and scholarship waiver.

title: Disability scholarship application forwarded with wrong category code
description: The scholarship desk submitted my application under general category instead of PwD category, causing it to be rejected by the state portal.

title: Economically backward class (EBC) concession cancelled unexpectedly
description: My 50% fee concession under the EBC scheme was unilaterally discontinued without any change in family income or academic standing.

title: Minority scholarship biometric authentication machine not working
description: The scholarship cell biometric scanner required for central minority scholarship re-validation has been malfunctioning for a week.

title: Alumni endowment fund financial aid check bounced
description: The financial assistance check provided from the alumni emergency student fund was returned by the bank due to signature mismatch.

title: Bonafide scholarship certificate for external foundation delayed
description: An external philanthropic trust offering Rs. 50,000 scholarship requires an institutional bonafide with fee breakdown, which the office refuses to issue.

title: Contaminated drinking water in Block B boys hostel
description: The RO water purifier in Block B hostel has been dispensing turbid, foul-smelling water. Multiple students have fallen ill with stomach infections.

title: Hostel mess food quality unhygienic with insects found
description: Insects were found in the dinner dal and rice at the girls hostel mess. Despite complaints to the warden, hygiene has not improved.

title: Frequent power outages in hostel without backup generator
description: Hostel Block C suffers from 6-hour daily electricity cuts during exam week, and the diesel backup generator has not been fueled.

title: Hostel room ceiling plaster collapsing during monsoon
description: Water leakage from the hostel ceiling has caused concrete plaster to peel and fall onto study desks in room 304.

title: Broken bathroom doors and unhygienic washrooms in Block A
description: Four out of six bathroom cubicles in the 2nd floor hostel wing have broken latches and no running water in the morning.

title: Unfair room allotment by hostel administration
description: Senior students were allotted triple-sharing rooms while junior quota rooms with AC were given out through non-transparent favoritism.

title: Excessive and discriminatory curfew timings for girls hostel
description: The girls hostel imposes a 6:30 PM curfew while boys hostel is open until 10:30 PM, restricting access to the central campus library.

title: Non-functioning air coolers in summer with 44 degree heat
description: The desert coolers in the top floor rooms have damaged motors and the hostel caretaker has refused to repair them despite multiple complaints.

title: Stray dogs entering hostel corridors and biting students
description: The hostel boundary wall is broken, allowing aggressive stray dog packs to roam inside the ground floor residential corridors at night.

title: Hostel security guards misbehaving with residents
description: The evening security guards verbally abuse students returning from lab work and refuse entry even with valid departmental permission slips.

title: No hot water in winter due to broken solar water heaters
description: The solar geyser system in the winter months has been out of service for three weeks with zero maintenance response.

title: Theft of laptops and personal belongings in hostel rooms
description: Multiple locked rooms on the first floor were broken into over the weekend. The warden refuses to check CCTV cameras or call police.

title: Hostel laundry washing machines broken down for a month
description: All four coin-operated laundry machines in the common facility are out of order, forcing 300 residents to wash heavy bedding by hand.

title: Bedbug infestation in dormitory mattresses
description: The provided wooden beds and mattresses in Block D have severe bedbug infestation causing sleep deprivation and allergic rashes.

title: Unjustified fines levied on entire hostel floor for corridor noise
description: The warden imposed a collective fine of Rs. 1,000 on every resident of the third floor without identifying individual culprits.

title: Campus wide Wi-Fi network disconnected across academic blocks
description: The institutional Wi-Fi network has been non-functional in the computer science and electronics departments for over two weeks, crippling research work.

title: Damaged laboratory equipment in digital electronics lab
description: More than half of the cathode ray oscilloscopes (CRO) and function generators in the circuit lab are defective, leaving students unable to complete experiments.

title: Central library books collection outdated and lacking textbooks
description: The library does not have copies of the prescribed syllabus textbooks for the 2024 revised regulation, with only 2 reference copies for 120 students.

title: Projectors in lecture halls non-functional with broken cables
description: Classroom 402 and 405 projectors have burnt out lamps and severed HDMI cables, making digital presentations and lectures impossible.

title: No air conditioning or ventilation in computer center
description: The high-performance computing lab housing 80 workstations has broken AC units, causing systems to thermal throttle and room temperatures to exceed 40C.

title: Sanitary washrooms unusable with blocked drainage in civil block
description: The student toilets in the Civil Engineering department have had overflowing drainage and no running water for five days.

title: Auditorium sound system malfunctioning during academic seminar
description: The audio equipment in the main seminar hall has severe feedback squeals and broken microphones, disrupting guest expert talks.

title: Broken desks and chairs causing injuries in lecture hall 101
description: Several wooden benches have exposed nails and splintered writing tablets that tear clothing and pose physical injury risks.

title: No drinking water facility on the 3rd floor of science block
description: The water cooler on the top floor has been disconnected for six months, forcing students to walk down three flights of stairs between classes.

title: Inadequate campus street lighting posing safety risks at night
description: The walkway connecting the engineering workshops and the main gate has zero working streetlights, making it pitch dark after 7 PM.

title: Elevator in academic block frequently trapped between floors
description: The passenger elevator in the 7-story administrative building has broken safety sensors and trapped four students for 45 minutes yesterday.

title: Chemistry lab fume hoods non-functional during acid experiments
description: The exhaust ventilation fume hoods in the organic chemistry laboratory are broken, exposing students to noxious chlorine and acid vapors.

title: Gymnasium equipment broken with frayed cables
description: The fitness center equipment has broken weight pulleys and frayed steel cables that risk causing serious physical trauma to users.

title: Campus bus service cancelled on key suburban transit routes
description: The college bus route serving the eastern suburbs was abruptly terminated without alternative transport arrangements for 80 day-scholars.

title: Canteen serving uninspected expired packaged food
description: The campus cafeteria was found selling beverages and snack packets past their printed best-before expiration date.

title: Delay in issuing official transfer and migration certificate
description: I applied for my migration certificate and transfer certificate (TC) three weeks ago for higher studies abroad. The administrative desk has not signed the documents.

title: Student ID card not issued after three months of enrollment
description: First-year engineering students have not been provided permanent RFID student ID cards, causing problems in accessing library and examination halls.

title: Bonafide certificate request ignored by academic registrar
description: An urgent bonafide certificate needed for passport renewal has been pending with the dispatch section for over 15 working days.

title: Incorrect date of birth recorded on permanent student profile
description: My 10th standard matriculation certificate shows DOB as 14/05/2003, but the university ERP database entered 14/05/2004 and refuses to rectify without affidavits.

title: Non-responsive administrative staff during counter inquiry hours
description: The student affairs counter closes 2 hours before the scheduled 4 PM closing time, leaving working students unable to submit clearance paperwork.

title: Delay in returning original 12th standard marksheets
description: Original school leaving certificates deposited during admission counseling have not been returned even after completing 2nd semester.

title: Official transcript sealed envelope not provided for WES evaluation
description: The registrar office refused to stamp and seal the international credential evaluation transcript envelope as per standard WES protocols.

title: Name change gazette notification not updated in university system
description: I submitted the official government gazette notification for my legal name change three months ago, but the degree portal still shows the old name.

title: No-dues clearance signature delayed by sports department
description: The physical education director is refusing to sign the final graduation clearance slip alleging unreturned sports kit that was never issued to me.

title: Medical leave application not entered into academic portal
description: Hospital discharge certificate submitted in person to the dean's office was misplaced, resulting in unjustified shortage of attendance record.

title: Character certificate issued with incorrect enrollment year
description: The character certificate mentions my study period as 2019-2022 instead of 2020-2024, creating doubts with prospective employers.

title: Provisional degree certificate verification email not answered
description: My recruiting employer's background verification agency sent two official verification emails that the university registrar has left unanswered for 30 days.

title: Student grievance cell contact details not displayed on website
description: The institutional website lacks the mandatory ombudsperson contact email, physical address, and grievance redressal committee phone numbers.

title: Bus pass concession form rejected due to clerk absence
description: The state transport bus concession forms require the college seal, but the designated clerk has been absent with no alternate staff assigned.

title: Duplicate security fee demanded for issuing replacement smart card
description: My student smart card was damaged due to reader defect, and the administrative office is imposing a punitive penalty instead of nominal replacement cost.

title: Physical ragging and harassment by senior students in hostel
description: Senior students forced first-year residents into room 204 at midnight, subjecting them to verbal humiliation and physical assault. Immediate anti-ragging squad intervention required.

title: Sexual harassment by faculty member during project review
description: A professor made inappropriate advances and suggestive remarks during a one-on-one thesis review, threatening poor marks if not complied with. Needs urgent Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) probe.

title: Verbal caste-based discrimination by department instructor
description: The lab assistant routinely uses derogatory casteist slurs against reserved category students and openly disparages affirmative action in class.

title: Cyberbullying and non-consensual image sharing on social media
description: Students from the senior batch created an anonymous Instagram page posting defaming memes and morphed photographs of female classmates without consent.

title: Physical brawl and weapon threat outside college gate
description: A group of hostile individuals gathered outside the main campus gate with iron rods and threatened junior students following a sports dispute.

title: Stalking and intimidation of student near campus library
description: A male student has been persistently following, cornering, and intimidating a female student on her walk to the girls hostel despite clear warnings to stop.

title: Extortion of money from junior day-scholars on college buses
description: Third-year students are demanding weekly cash payments from first-year students on bus route 14 under threat of physical violence.

title: Religious discrimination and slurs used during cultural fest auditions
description: Organizers of the annual festival made derogatory communal remarks and excluded students on the basis of their religious background.

title: Smoking and illicit substance abuse inside hostel common room
description: A group of residents openly consumes alcohol and narcotics in the 3rd floor lounge, creating an unsafe and intimidating environment for other students.

title: Vandalism of student vehicle parked in campus parking lot
description: My two-wheeler had its tires slashed and fuel tank damaged by senior students after an argument regarding student council elections.

title: Dean of student welfare not taking action on formal ragging complaint
description: A written complaint against senior students submitted to the anti-ragging committee 10 days ago has not yielded any inquiry or protective measures.

title: Blackmail and extortion by laboratory assistant for viva marks
description: The technician demands personal favors and electronic gadgets under threat of failing students in the end semester practical examination.

title: Hostile environment and verbal abuse by departmental security guard
description: The main building guard routinely directs misogynistic comments towards female scholars wearing western attire.

title: Threatening WhatsApp messages sent to student election candidates
description: Anonymous burner phone numbers are sending death threats and kidnapping warnings to candidate running for student senate president.

title: Forced participation in unofficial senior initiation rituals
description: First-year students are being coerced into performing degrading chores and physical drills late at night under threat of social boycott.

title: Wheelchair ramp missing at main entrance of examination center
description: The examination building has a steep 8-step staircase with no wheelchair ramp, making it inaccessible for students with locomotive disabilities.

title: Elevator key withheld from orthopedically disabled student
description: The elevator operator locked the lift and refused access to a student on crutches, claiming the lift is reserved exclusively for senior faculty.

title: Scribe allocation denied for visually impaired student for exams
description: The examination cell has refused to approve an authorized scribe for a student with 80% visual impairment despite timely medical submission.

title: Screen reading software not installed in campus computer laboratory
description: The department computers lack JAWS or NVDA accessibility software required for blind students taking programming practicals.

title: No braille signage or tactile paving in new academic complex
description: The newly inaugurated multi-story building lacks braille room number plates and tactile floor guiding paths for visually impaired students.

title: Mental health counseling center closed during peak exam period
description: The campus psychological counselor is unavailable and the counseling cell has remained locked for three weeks during semester examinations.

title: Accessible disability washroom locked and used as janitor storage
description: The only dedicated PwD toilet on the ground floor is locked with a padlock and filled with cleaning mops and chemical drums.

title: Sign language interpreter not provided for hearing impaired student
description: Class lectures and university orientation presentations have zero sign language assistance or live captions for deaf students.

title: Emergency medical room lacks basic first aid and oxygen cylinder
description: When a student suffered an acute asthma attack in class, the health center had no inhaler or oxygen and the nurse was absent.

title: Audio textbooks and accessible digital study materials unavailable
description: The central library has not provided digital accessible format textbooks or audiobooks requested by students with learning disabilities.

title: Classroom relocation denied for student with temporary leg fracture
description: The academic head refused to move a core class from the 4th floor to the ground floor for a student recovering from knee surgery.

title: Ambulance not available during on-campus sports injury emergency
description: A student suffered a compound fracture during football practice, and the university ambulance had a dead battery and no driver.

title: Special accommodation time not granted during continuous assessments
description: Dyslexic student with approved medical dispensation was not granted the statutory 20 minutes compensatory extra time per hour.

title: Hostel room on ground floor denied to student with severe disability
description: A student with cerebral palsy was allotted a room on the third floor of a hostel block with no functioning elevator.

title: Sensory overload safe room not provided during campus festivals
description: Neurodivergent students requested a quiet sensory space during the annual festival which was dismissed without consideration.

title: Lost and found desk at student union not maintaining register
description: Valuable items turned in at the student union desk are not logged in any logbook, leading to lost wristwatches and calculators going missing.

title: Campus stray cattle causing traffic obstruction near gates
description: Cows and stray animals frequently block the main vehicular entrance, causing near accidents during morning rush hours.

title: Disposal of biomedical waste behind campus clinic unhygienic
description: Used syringes and cotton swabs are dumped in an open plastic bin behind the health center without biohazard segregation.

title: Parking fee charged for bicycles inside student parking shed
description: Contractor at the bicycle stand is unlawfully charging students Rs. 10 daily despite campus guidelines allowing free non-motorized parking.

title: Noise pollution from unauthorized construction near study hall
description: Heavy jackhammers and drilling machines are operated adjacent to the reading room during designated quiet study hours.

title: Campus bank branch ATM out of cash for two consecutive weeks
description: The solitary automated teller machine on campus has displayed 'Out of Service' for 14 days with no cash replenishment.

title: Courier and parcel delivery packages denied entry at security gate
description: Guards refuse to accept educational book parcels or admit courier delivery agents, forcing students to miss class to collect books outside.

title: College magazine editorial committee rejecting articles arbitrarily
description: The student editorial board is censoring student opinion pieces without clear editorial criteria or faculty review.

title: Alumni association portal registration link broken
description: Graduating seniors attempting to register for the official alumni network find the portal link returning 500 server errors.

title: Lack of waste segregation bins across campus walkways
description: No separate green and blue waste bins are provided, leading to plastic bottles and food waste mixing in open overflow bins.

title: Campus bookstore charging above printed maximum retail price (MRP)
description: The authorized cooperative store is selling stationary and engineering chart sheets at prices exceeding the manufacturer MRP.

title: Bird nests and pigeon droppings inside central library reading room
description: Open windows in the library reading room allow pigeons to enter, causing unhygienic droppings on tables and book racks.

title: Tree branches falling on parked vehicles during thunderstorm
description: Overhanging dead branches near the staff quarters parking have not been trimmed and crushed a student scooter yesterday.

title: Campus postal sub-office not selling standard postal stamps
description: The on-campus post office frequently runs out of standard stamps and registered post envelopes needed for official job applications.

title: General inquiry desk phone number unanswered during business hours
description: The central switchboard telephone number published on the university portal rings out continuously with no receptionist answering.
